steps.en: Link the skill into your harness and log gh into the project's GitHub repo
steps.zh: 把 skill 链进 harness，gh 登录项目所在的 GitHub 仓库

steps.en: Say what you want to build, in plain words
steps.zh: 用大白话说你想做什么

steps.en: Brainstorms scope with you, writes a PRD, then parses it into a technical epic
steps.zh: 先追问范围写成 PRD，再转成技术 epic

steps.en: Ask it to break the epic down and sync it to GitHub
steps.zh: 让它拆解 epic，并同步到 GitHub
steps.code: "break down the X epic" · "sync the X epic to GitHub"

steps.en: Writes task files with dependency flags, opens an epic issue plus sub-issues, sets up a worktree
steps.zh: 写带依赖标记的任务文件，建 epic 和子 issue，开 worktree

steps.en: Splits the issue into independent streams and launches parallel agents that commit per issue
steps.zh: 把 issue 拆成互不冲突的几路，并行派 agent，按 issue 提交

value.en: Every commit traces back to a written spec, and progress sits in GitHub Issues instead of a chat log
value.zh: 每个提交都能追到写下来的需求，进度在 GitHub Issues 里而不是聊天记录里

sources: https://github.com/automazeio/ccpm README Install (Claude Code: ln -s /path/to/ccpm/skill/ccpm .claude/skills/ccpm; prerequisites gh auth login) — read 2026-10-08
README Usage / Natural language triggers ("I want to build X", "break down the X epic", "sync the X epic to GitHub", "start working on issue N")
README Workflow Phases (.claude/prds/<name>.md, .claude/epics/<name>/epic.md, depends_on / parallel / conflicts_with, commit format Issue #N: description)
